LockedDesc: Lucia is trying out a new hobby.
UnlockedDesc: At Liv's suggestion, Lucia has started gardening. She checks on her seedlings every day.

LockedDesc: Someone said they spotted Lucia somewhere up high.
UnlockedDesc: Lucia believes the bustle of people is proof of their hopes for the future.

LockedDesc: Lucia is thinking in front of a canvas.
UnlockedDesc: Lucia's Froggie drawing has been praised as "vivid and adorable." She came to the art gallery specifically to improve her skills.\nEncouraging her is also part of a Commandant's duty.

LockedDesc: Greet Teddy, who's watching a movie.
UnlockedDesc: Teddy sometimes tests her "new toys" at the Babylonia Universal Cinema. Drop by if you want to see how it's going.

LockedDesc: Find Teddy walking around the square.
UnlockedDesc: To make her compositions more interesting, Teddy collects sound samples around Convergence Square.

LockedDesc: Teddy gazes at the projection, lost in thought.
UnlockedDesc: The projection at the art gallery is Teddy's work, though she doesn't think it's perfect yet.

LockedDesc: Vera seems deep in thought in front of the movie poster.
UnlockedDesc: Vera is often mistaken for one of the performers, and people frequently ask her for autographs.\nMaybe you could ask her for one too?

LockedDesc: From time to time, a vivid red figure can be seen at Dreamglow Gardens.
UnlockedDesc: When she has some free time, Vera goes to Dreamglow Gardens to relax.

LockedDesc: Vera seems to want to talk about supplies.
UnlockedDesc: Vera helps check the delivered supplies. As thanks, you could treat her to a drink.

LockedDesc: When lilies are in bloom, Bianca always visits Dreamglow Gardens.
UnlockedDesc: And so, a promise was made with Bianca to admire the flowers together every spring. Life works that way—once spring's wishes come true, we begin to long for summer's. The seasons turn, year after year.

LockedDesc: While waiting for the movie to start, Bianca always takes time to enjoy the view at Universal Square.
UnlockedDesc: As Bianca watches the scenery from the bridge, those watching the scenery are also watching her.\nEvery beautiful moment in life feels like a scene unfolding on film.\nNow, say that line.

LockedDesc: In the theater lobby, Bianca still hasn't decided what to watch next.
UnlockedDesc: The more Bianca understands how stories are made, the higher her standards become.\nNo longer carried forward by others' narratives, she has begun writing her own script.

LockedDesc: Rosetta likes places with plenty of plants.
UnlockedDesc: Greenery is a luxury in Arctic regions, and that's exactly what makes it so beautiful. Rosetta often comes here to think. If you have time, you might hear some of her stories from the Arctic.

LockedDesc: Rosetta seems interested in the projection at the square.
UnlockedDesc: The glow of the projection reminds Rosetta of habits from her past. In her view, no matter where people are, what they seek is often the same.

LockedDesc: Rosetta can be found near the whale projection.
UnlockedDesc: The whale projection has caught Rosetta's attention. From the way she describes it, riding on Derek's back would be an extraordinary experience. Maybe try it next time.

LockedDesc: Dreamglow Gardens offers many opportunities for children at the Youth Center to learn about ecology.
UnlockedDesc: Wanshi's return gift comes in the form of fun ecological facts and playful bee pranks. What the children receive, however, is an image of their homeland and a precious bond with their teacher.

LockedDesc: With a bit of planning, movie theaters are great places for a nap.
UnlockedDesc: Wanshi's Odd Jobs exists to help whenever people run into trouble.\nWanshi is such a gentle soul.

LockedDesc: Wanshi seems to have booked a visit to an art exhibition at the Olympia Art Gallery.
UnlockedDesc: After carefully studying WGAA's organizational practices, Wanshi has completed two-fifths of the proposal to establish the Hibernation Association, even though the co-proposer still has no idea it exists.

LockedDesc: Slipping naturally into work mode, even at the Logistics Center—that's Lee's "talent."
UnlockedDesc: As everyone knows, maintaining the Gray Raven Commandant's exoskeleton has become part of Lee's daily duties. However, who should handle the "body measurements" part of the preparation... is still up for debate.

LockedDesc: Lee often seems to rest in a spot near the Military Security Area in the Knowledge Promenade.
UnlockedDesc: Maybe the ice cream really was that good that day. Lee often chooses this place to unwind. Life keeps changing, but thankfully, the people around us stay the same.

LockedDesc: Standing by the window at Dreamglow Gardens, you can see the silent expanse of the universe.
UnlockedDesc: When talking about the past, many things turn out to be different from what we remember. Those differences are like a cat's secrets. They have to be whispered more softly than a kitten's meow, or someone might notice.

LockedDesc: Even Asimov struggles to decide what movie to watch.
UnlockedDesc: Recommending films from unfamiliar genres is usually a good way to help meticulous researchers relax and enjoy a story. For Asimov, who "knows everything," it doesn't seem to work.

LockedDesc: The Science Council is also one of the organizing bodies behind Dreamglow Gardens.
UnlockedDesc: Asimov has a lot on his mind: Punishing, Constructs, new "research subjects" occasionally brought back by the Gray Raven Commandant, and... making sure every survivor gets a proper meal.

LockedDesc: A busy Logistics Center, and an even busier Asimov.
UnlockedDesc: Asimov assigns different notification tones to different contacts as a basic priority system. But who he replies to first is purely a matter of personal favo—no, personal feeling.

LockedDesc: According to some students, an Ascendant's silhouette is occasionally spotted on the third floor of the teaching center.
UnlockedDesc: During a previous battle, Alpha's conversation with students was accidentally recorded, but the content of this recording seems to change under certain circumstances.

LockedDesc: In the training room, Kamui is troubled by suggestions for the physical combat class.
UnlockedDesc: According to Instructor Kamui's assessment, the battle modules recorded in the combat robot system are somewhat outdated.

LockedDesc: In the corridor outside the classroom, a figure is carefully observing something.
UnlockedDesc: Quality educational resources have always been a luxury. Kamui's gaze toward students is always gentle... and carries a hint of envy.\nHowever, rather than attending classes, what Kamui values more is enjoying the time spent together with everyone.

LockedDesc: In front of the Pioneer Memorials, someone quietly recites something.
UnlockedDesc: Beneath his cheerful exterior, Kamui has a sensitive heart.

LockedDesc: There's always a long queue in front of the food stall in the Overlapping Ring District. The aroma has drawn Kamui in.
UnlockedDesc: Once F.O.S.'s renovations are officially completed, let's invite Kamui to your favorite food stall.

LockedDesc: Kamui looks troubled about something in front of the Spectrum Garden. Don't tell me he's lost?
UnlockedDesc: Kamui isn't as rough around the edges as he appears to be. I'm sure he can offer excellent practical combat advice.

LockedDesc: Someone seems rather dissatisfied as they look at the training room's simulation scores.
UnlockedDesc: Vanessa wants to see more outstanding talents emerge. Her high standards apply not only to herself, but also to everyone around her.

LockedDesc: Outside the window of the study room, a pair of sharp eyes is sizing up the interior.
UnlockedDesc: Although she's sharp-tongued, Vanessa still went in and offered guidance to the junior students who were struggling with certain problems.\n"For this problem, if you just read the military topography professor's 'High Ground' a few more times, you'll know the answer."

LockedDesc: Distinguished graduates will be invited to give motivational speeches in the Golden Hall, and Vanessa is one of them.
UnlockedDesc: Appropriately dressed with perfect posture—even during rehearsals, Vanessa is flawless.

LockedDesc: Vanessa is at the observation deck in the Spectrum Garden. Does she also get nostalgic?
UnlockedDesc: If Vanessa finds fault with the campus environment, she will definitely take action to personally rectify it.

LockedDesc: Inside the solemn Golden Hall, former students all have something on their minds.
UnlockedDesc: Over the years, Chrome gradually walked out of the shadows of his past. The people around him have played a significant role in this.

LockedDesc: It's been a busy period for the logistics conveyor belts at the transportation hub recently, so Babylonia has dispatched personnel to oversee operations.
UnlockedDesc: Chrome has fallen into his hyper-focused work mode again. You'll need to wait until he finishes his work to talk to him.

LockedDesc: The F.O.S. Memorial is one of F.O.S.'s landmarks, and many people are always here to pay their respects.
UnlockedDesc: This is the vision shared by everyone, including Chrome and you—may every child of humanity be able to return home safely!

LockedDesc: Inside the Collaborative Teaching Center, Chrome is furrowing his brow. What could be troubling him?
UnlockedDesc: F.O.S. is currently going through a sensitive period, and both the security department and Chrome, who came to help, are quite busy.

LockedDesc: Club activities often take place near the Overlapping Ring District, and Chrome seems to have taken an interest in this.
UnlockedDesc: If you were students in the same grade, perhaps you could establish a chess club together.\nEven if the members were only Chrome and you, that would be enough.

LockedDesc: At the entrance of the busy transportation hub, Liv quietly waits for you.
UnlockedDesc: At the entrance to the transportation hub, you'll find Miss Liv, who is very strict about appearances.

LockedDesc: Liv occasionally sits down on the bench at the Life Services Station to rest.
UnlockedDesc: If you encounter Liv by the bench at the Life Services Station, you should sit with her for a while.

LockedDesc: Liv seems to be waiting for someone by the window in the back row of Study Hall 4.
UnlockedDesc: She hopes to experience the wonderful school life together with you, where she would wait for you, her deskmate, in the back row of the classroom.

LockedDesc: After the ceremony ends, Liv stands beside the Golden Hall's podium, lost in thought.
UnlockedDesc: In Liv's eyes, you'll always be the most brilliant one on the Golden Hall's podium.

LockedDesc: Outside of work, Nirvatia also goes to the Life Services Station to watch drone test flights.
UnlockedDesc: Finding time for leisure amid a busy schedule is an art form in itself, and watching drone test flights is one of Nirvatia's greatest pleasures at F.O.S.

LockedDesc: A crowd has completely surrounded Nirvatia at the entrance of the teaching center.
UnlockedDesc: To accelerate F.O.S.'s reconstruction progress, Nirvatia provides professional advice to the school administration at the entrance of the teaching center.

LockedDesc: Nirvatia, who's an information security expert, is putting her expertise to use in the terminal room.
UnlockedDesc: As the Science Council Security Director, Nirvatia would help F.O.S. build a more robust network defense system.

LockedDesc: I heard an honorary lecturer showed up in Study Hall 3 recently. I wonder who it could be.
UnlockedDesc: Though she's only an honorary lecturer, Nirvatia seems genuinely enthusiastic about teaching. You can occasionally spot her in Study Hall 3.
